front.title: A Framework for Agent Discovery in DAWN

abstract.t: This document describes a two-layer reference architecture for discovering the Minimum Discoverable Information (MDI) for AI agents. The Local Discovery Plane collects agent information through mDNS on each participating LAN and infrastructure-assisted registration, and the Federation Gateway combines these sources into a policy- controlled view of the administrative domain. For cross-domain discovery, the Federation Plane uses DNS publication of policy- approved information in authoritative DNS zones and on-demand resolution as its baseline; Federation Gateways apply export policy and validate and cache accepted results. The document also identifies optional functions that may complement this baseline where DNS publication and request-driven resolution do not meet deployment needs: recipient-specific sharing, proactive or multi-hop dissemination, and trusted aggregated directory queries. In mixed- mode deployments, DNS may bootstrap an endpoint that provides one of these additional functions.
